answer: Sybil resistance follows from time-weighted EigenTrust: reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so an identity must sustain honest, reciprocated service to retain influence. A newly spawned identity has little trusted history and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot bootstrap it through untrusted peers, leaving it below consensus thresholds. Accounts named grove, raven, or atlas gain no standing merely by appearing.
